operations.description: Comment on a post or reply to a top-level comment as the member or an organization it posts for (POST /rest/socialActions/{target}/comments).
Delete a comment and its replies; allowed for its actor and the post's author (DELETE /rest/socialActions/{target}/comments/{commentId}).
One comment of a thread (GET /rest/socialActions/{target}/comments/{commentId}).
Top-level comments of a post, or replies of a comment, oldest first (GET /rest/socialActions/{target}/comments).
Edit a comment's text and mentions; only its actor may (POST /rest/socialActions/{target}/comments/{commentId}, PARTIAL_UPDATE).
The caller's first-degree connections, newest first, with case-insensitive name/headline search (canonical only).
Home feed of the caller, its connections and followed or managed organizations, newest first, with the world's virtual time (canonical only).
Follower count of an organization (GET /rest/networkSizes/{urn}?edgeType=COMPANY_FOLLOWED_BY_MEMBER) or the caller's connection count (GET /v2/connections/{personUrn}).
Organization roles of the caller (q=roleAssignee) or of an administered organization (q=organization) (GET /rest/organizationAcls).
Non-admin fields of the organization with a vanity name, case-insensitive (GET /rest/organizations?q=vanityName).
Full organization record for an approved ADMINISTRATOR (GET /rest/organizations/{id}).
Lite profile of a member present in the network (GET /v2/people/(id:{personId})).
Publish a text, article or reshare post as the member or an organization it posts for (POST /rest/posts, POST /v2/ugcPosts).
Delete a post; repeat deletes succeed and its comments and reactions are removed (DELETE /rest/posts/{postUrn}, DELETE /v2/ugcPosts/{urn}).
Read one post by share or ugcPost URN (GET /rest/posts/{postUrn}); drafts only with viewContext=AUTHOR.
Find posts by author, newest first by LAST_MODIFIED or CREATED (GET /rest/posts?q=author).
Partially update a post's commentary or publish a draft (POST /rest/posts/{postUrn} with X-RestLi-Method: PARTIAL_UPDATE).
Lite profile of the calling member (GET /v2/me).
OpenID Connect userinfo of the member the token belongs to (GET /v2/userinfo); e-mail fields need the email scope.
React to a post or comment; a different type replaces the actor's earlier reaction (POST /rest/reactions?actor=).
Remove the actor's reaction from an entity (DELETE /rest/reactions/(actor:{urn},entity:{urn})).
Reactions on an entity (GET /rest/reactions/(entity:{urn})?q=entity) or one reaction by compound key (GET /rest/reactions/(actor:{urn},entity:{urn})).
Reaction and comment summaries and comments state of a post or comment (GET /rest/socialMetadata/{entity}).
Open or close a post's comments; closing deletes existing comments (POST /rest/socialMetadata/{entity}?actor=).

connections.title: LinkedIn REST client (test process)
connections.instructions: Point the client's base URL (paths /rest/... and /v2/...) at LINKEDIN_API_BASE_URL and send LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN as the Bearer token. Send LinkedIn-Version: 202608 on /rest routes. Test processes only.
